idea-plugin.name: Revision Graph for Git (SVN style)
idea-plugin.description:
A TortoiseSVN-style revision graph for Git, right inside your JetBrains IDE (IntelliJ IDEA, WebStorm, PyCharm, GoLand, …). Commits, local and remote branches, and tags appear as connected, color-coded boxes. Right-click a commit to branch, check out, merge, or copy its SHA.
A separate build targets Huawei DevEco Studio; both are produced from the same shared codebase.

action.description: Open the SVN-style revision graph as an editor tab
